capabilities.label: Normalized sigmoid contrast
capabilities.mechanism: Apply a normalized logistic curve in bounded luminance coordinates, preserving black and HDR output.
capabilities.name: Normalized sigmoid contrast
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Exponential highlight rolloff
capabilities.mechanism: Use an exponential absorption shoulder normalized at unit white.
capabilities.name: Exponential highlight rolloff
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Monotone Hermite contrast
capabilities.mechanism: Shape a cubic Hermite contrast curve with matching endpoint slopes and a continuous HDR extension.
capabilities.name: Monotone Hermite contrast
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Rational light bias
capabilities.mechanism: Redistribute linear luminance with a rational bias curve and continuous highlight extension.
capabilities.name: Rational light bias
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Luminance solarization
capabilities.mechanism: Fold luminance above an explicit threshold into an exponential creative solarization shoulder.
capabilities.name: Luminance solarization
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Stop-zone exposure lift
capabilities.mechanism: Apply a Gaussian exposure lift around a chosen stop-domain luminance anchor.
capabilities.name: Stop-zone exposure lift
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Linear black-floor subtraction
capabilities.mechanism: Subtract an explicit linear black floor and rescale the remaining luminance.
capabilities.name: Linear black-floor subtraction
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Selected dark-channel haze removal
capabilities.mechanism: Estimate local transmission from selected dark-channel minima and selected 99th-percentile atmospheric channel values.
capabilities.name: Selected dark-channel haze removal
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Variance-guided luminance cleanup
capabilities.mechanism: Shrink local luminance residuals using the Wiener ratio of measured variance to variance plus noise power.
capabilities.name: Variance-guided luminance cleanup
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Local extrema tone contraction
capabilities.mechanism: Contract luminance toward the midpoint of selected neighbourhood extrema.
capabilities.name: Local extrema tone contraction
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Opponent-plane colour shear
capabilities.mechanism: Shear red-opponent chroma by blue-opponent chroma while retaining photographed luminance.
capabilities.name: Opponent-plane colour shear
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Radius-dependent hue spiral
capabilities.mechanism: Rotate hue by a continuous angle proportional to colour radius, keeping neutral colours stable.
capabilities.name: Radius-dependent hue spiral
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Luminance-dependent hue twist
capabilities.mechanism: Rotate shadows and highlights in opposing hue directions around a luminance anchor.
capabilities.name: Luminance-dependent hue twist
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Complementary duotone gradient
capabilities.mechanism: Rebuild chroma along a complementary shadow-to-highlight colour axis at original luminance.
capabilities.name: Complementary duotone gradient
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Cyclic channel crossfeed
capabilities.mechanism: Mix each linear channel with its cyclic neighbour and restore original luminance.
capabilities.name: Cyclic channel crossfeed
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Subtractive colour density
capabilities.mechanism: Apply Beer-Lambert channel absorption from an explicit density colour and restore original luminance.
capabilities.name: Subtractive colour density
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Bradford cone-response adaptation
capabilities.mechanism: Adapt the selected mean illuminant to an explicit target using XYZ Bradford cone responses, retaining luminance.
capabilities.name: Bradford cone-response adaptation
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: RGB channel-ratio limiter
capabilities.mechanism: Limit peak channels against the darkest channel with a luminance-based stabilizing floor.
capabilities.name: RGB channel-ratio limiter
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Median-channel spill suppression
capabilities.mechanism: Reduce only channel excursions above the per-pixel median channel and restore luminance.
capabilities.name: Median-channel spill suppression
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Three-axis hue harmony
capabilities.mechanism: Move hue toward a target-aligned threefold harmonic harmony using a continuous sinusoidal angular field.
capabilities.name: Three-axis hue harmony
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Colour-luminance regression removal
capabilities.mechanism: Measure selected chroma-versus-luminance regression and remove its slope around the selected mean.
capabilities.name: Colour-luminance regression removal
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Luminance-guided colour cleanup
capabilities.mechanism: Fit local chroma to luminance with ridge-regularized selected covariance, preserving aligned colour edges.
capabilities.name: Luminance-guided colour cleanup
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Weighted median colour repair
capabilities.mechanism: Replace opponent chroma with the weighted selected neighbourhood median, preserving luminance.
capabilities.name: Weighted median colour repair
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Channel-distribution alignment
capabilities.mechanism: Map each channel rank to the luminance-weighted barycenter of selected channel quantile distributions, preserving luminance.
capabilities.name: Channel-distribution alignment
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Range-aware bilateral colour cleanup
capabilities.mechanism: Average selected chroma with both spatial and chromatic range weights at constant luminance.
capabilities.name: Range-aware bilateral colour cleanup
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Adaptive impulse median
capabilities.mechanism: Expand the selected median neighborhood up to seven cells to identify isolated bright or dark impulses.
capabilities.name: Adaptive impulse median
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Sigma-gated colour smoothing
capabilities.mechanism: Average only selected neighbours within an explicit RGB distance from the current pixel.
capabilities.name: Sigma-gated colour smoothing
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Distance-weighted colour median
capabilities.mechanism: Estimate each channel with a weighted median that favors nearby selected samples.
capabilities.name: Distance-weighted colour median
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Luminance percentile limiter
capabilities.mechanism: Clamp luminance to the selected neighborhood tenth and ninetieth percentiles while retaining channel ratios.
capabilities.name: Luminance percentile limiter
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Chroma range smoothing
capabilities.mechanism: Average colour differences with chroma-distance and spatial weights while preserving luminance.
capabilities.name: Chroma range smoothing
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Chroma covariance denoising
capabilities.mechanism: Measure two-dimensional chroma covariance and shrink its noisy principal components while preserving luminance.
capabilities.name: Chroma covariance denoising
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Colour covariance denoising
capabilities.mechanism: Diagonalize measured local RGB covariance and suppress components below the chosen noise floor.
capabilities.name: Colour covariance denoising
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Entropy-weighted detail
capabilities.mechanism: Measure an eight-bin local luminance entropy and use it to weight residual detail gain.
capabilities.name: Entropy-weighted detail
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Local RMS contrast
capabilities.mechanism: Rescale luminance residuals toward a chosen local RMS contrast, with bounded gain.
capabilities.name: Local RMS contrast
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Log-illumination correction
capabilities.mechanism: Estimate geometric mean illumination and move it toward an authored reference while retaining reflectance.
capabilities.name: Log-illumination correction
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Oriented periodic notch
capabilities.mechanism: Fit a local sine and cosine at an authored frequency and orientation, then subtract their bounded luminance contribution.
capabilities.name: Oriented periodic notch
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Cross-footprint median
capabilities.mechanism: Take a selected-only colour median along a cross rather than a square footprint.
capabilities.name: Cross-footprint median
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Curvature ridge detail
capabilities.mechanism: Measure Hessian principal curvature and adjust ridge contrast with a bounded luminance correction.
capabilities.name: Curvature ridge detail
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Coherent structure detail
capabilities.mechanism: Measure structure-tensor coherence to concentrate detail gain along consistent edges.
capabilities.name: Coherent structure detail
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Least-dispersion line median
capabilities.mechanism: Choose the colour median of the least dispersed horizontal, vertical, or diagonal selected line.
capabilities.name: Least-dispersion line median
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Curved-surface residual detail
capabilities.mechanism: Fit a local six-term quadratic surface and adjust residual detail above smooth curved illumination.
capabilities.name: Curved-surface residual detail
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Windowed-sinc selection shift
capabilities.mechanism: Resample an explicit shift with a six-tap Lanczos kernel and clamp ringing to the selected footprint range.
capabilities.name: Windowed-sinc selection shift
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Elliptical aperture integration
capabilities.mechanism: Integrate a rotated elliptical Gaussian aperture within the selection.
capabilities.name: Elliptical aperture integration
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Hexagonal aperture integration
capabilities.mechanism: Integrate a uniform six-sided aperture with selection-aware samples.
capabilities.name: Hexagonal aperture integration
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Cat-eye aperture integration
capabilities.mechanism: Integrate intersecting discs; aperture clipping increases away from the authored optical centre.
capabilities.name: Cat-eye aperture integration
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: One-sided highlight streak
capabilities.mechanism: Spread only brighter-than-current highlight energy along a rotated exponential trail.
capabilities.name: One-sided highlight streak
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Range-aware base compression
capabilities.mechanism: Compress a luminance-range-filtered local base while retaining its fine residual.
capabilities.name: Range-aware base compression
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Selected dark-channel haze repair
capabilities.mechanism: Estimate selected airlight and local dark-channel transmission for bounded haze inversion. This is a heuristic, not scene-depth inference.
capabilities.name: Selected dark-channel haze repair
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Connected spot repair
capabilities.mechanism: Repair colour-connected components of at most four working cells from their selected boundary median.
capabilities.name: Connected spot repair
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Luminance-preserving chroma median
capabilities.mechanism: Apply channel-difference medians while retaining luminance and reducing out-of-gamut chroma.
capabilities.name: Luminance-preserving chroma median
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: CIE Lab sampled distance
capabilities.mechanism: Convert source sRGB through D65 XYZ into CIE Lab; select by CIE76 distance to the sample. Tolerance scales to 150 Lab units.
capabilities.name: CIE Lab sampled distance
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Covariance colour distance
capabilities.mechanism: Estimate a regularized RGB covariance in the sample patch and select by Mahalanobis distance. Flat patches remain finite; this measures colour statistics, not subjects.
capabilities.name: Covariance colour distance
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Geodesic colour propagation
capabilities.mechanism: Propagate from the sample by minimum accumulated RGB edge cost with deterministic integer Dijkstra traversal. Radius sets cost budget and tolerance sets colour crossing cost.
capabilities.name: Geodesic colour propagation
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Local Otsu threshold
capabilities.mechanism: Choose a separate 16-bin between-class variance threshold in each local luminance patch. Flat patches are excluded. Produces hard coverage.
capabilities.name: Local Otsu threshold
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Sauvola adaptive threshold
capabilities.mechanism: Compare source luminance with a local mean and standard-deviation threshold. Corner sets the Sauvola coefficient; pure black stays unselected.
capabilities.name: Sauvola adaptive threshold
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Gabor frequency response
capabilities.mechanism: Measure DC-removed Gaussian-windowed cosine response. Angle sets frequency direction; corner maps wavelength from 2 to 16 cells. Select the response with the range.
capabilities.name: Gabor frequency response
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Directional bright ridges
capabilities.mechanism: Project the source Hessian onto an angle and select negative curvature. This isolates bright ridges rather than first-derivative edges.
capabilities.name: Directional bright ridges
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Local tonal skewness
capabilities.mechanism: Measure the third standardized local luminance moment. Symmetry and flat patches map to 0.5; positive outlier tails map above it.
capabilities.name: Local tonal skewness
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Local tonal kurtosis
capabilities.mechanism: Measure local excess fourth standardized luminance moment, centered at 0.5 and scaled by 12. Flat patches map to 0.5.
capabilities.name: Local tonal kurtosis
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Colour-line residual
capabilities.mechanism: Estimate the dominant RGB covariance direction in a sample patch using power iteration. Select perpendicular distance to that colour line; this can isolate colours outside a shading ramp.
capabilities.name: Colour-line residual
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Grayscale morphological opening
capabilities.mechanism: Erode then dilate coverage with the same square structuring element. Removes thin bright protrusions and retains grayscale values. Outside-frame coverage is transparent.
capabilities.name: Grayscale morphological opening
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Grayscale morphological closing
capabilities.mechanism: Dilate then erode coverage with the same square structuring element. Bridges small dark gaps. Transparent boundaries can trim coverage at the frame edge.
capabilities.name: Grayscale morphological closing
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Opening by reconstruction
capabilities.mechanism: Erode coverage to form a marker, then propagate its grayscale maxima under the original coverage ceiling. Connected surviving regions recover their contours.
capabilities.name: Opening by reconstruction
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Grayscale area opening
capabilities.mechanism: Build descending upper-level components with a union-find max-tree. Suppress bright structures whose area is below the minimum at each coverage level.
capabilities.name: Grayscale area opening
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Keep border-connected regions
capabilities.mechanism: Retain complete four-connected regions that touch any frame edge at the 50% coverage threshold. Preserves retained grayscale coverage.
capabilities.name: Keep border-connected regions
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Seed geodesic distance bands
capabilities.mechanism: Measure shortest four-neighbor path distance inside the 50% selection from the sample. Range selects distance divided by radius; disconnected islands remain excluded.
capabilities.name: Seed geodesic distance bands
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Keep regions enclosing holes
capabilities.mechanism: Flood each component complement from a padded exterior to detect enclosed holes. Retain the surrounding component, preserving its coverage; solid regions are excluded.
capabilities.name: Keep regions enclosing holes
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Regional coverage maxima
capabilities.mechanism: Traverse equal-coverage plateaus and retain only nonzero plateaus with no greater four-neighbor coverage. Flat-topped maxima stay connected.
capabilities.name: Regional coverage maxima
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Archimedean spiral ribbon
capabilities.mechanism: Construct a ribbon around a growing Archimedean spiral within elliptical bounds. Radius sets turn count, angle rotates it, and tolerance sets radial half-width.
capabilities.name: Archimedean spiral ribbon
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Barycentric triangle gradient
capabilities.mechanism: Use the first three vertices to construct a triangle with coverage fading from vertex one toward the opposite edge. Corner controls the gradient exponent; collinear vertices are rejected.
capabilities.name: Barycentric triangle gradient
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Affine selection shear
capabilities.mechanism: Inverse-map coverage through a horizontal shear about the bounds center. Angle maps through sine to shear strength from -1.5 to 1.5. Transparent sampling clips outside the frame.
capabilities.name: Affine selection shear
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Radial selection twirl
capabilities.mechanism: Rotate source sample coordinates with a quadratic radial falloff inside elliptical bounds. Angle sets centre rotation; the ellipse boundary stays fixed.
capabilities.name: Radial selection twirl
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Spherical selection remap
capabilities.mechanism: Inverse-map coverage with a normalized arctangent radial projection inside elliptical bounds. Corner blends projection strength; the bounds boundary stays fixed.
capabilities.name: Spherical selection remap
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Image-gradient displacement
capabilities.mechanism: Move coverage sample coordinates along source luminance gradients. Tolerance sets displacement strength; source pixels remain read-only and out-of-frame coverage is transparent.
capabilities.name: Image-gradient displacement
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.label: Signed-distance edge smoothing
capabilities.mechanism: Compute graph distance on both sides of the 50% selection interface and remap it with a logistic profile. Radius sets softness; fully selected or empty frames retain exact coverage.
capabilities.name: Signed-distance edge smoothing
capabilities.implementation: Independent AURA implementation; Evoto numerical parity unverified.

capabilities.name: Luminance quantile landmarks
capabilities.description: Interpolated observed linear luminance landmarks; no assumed target exposure.
capabilities.mechanism: Interpolated observed linear luminance landmarks; no assumed target exposure.

capabilities.name: Robust luminance dispersion
capabilities.description: Median absolute departure from median luminance, interquartile range, and central 90% span.
capabilities.mechanism: Median absolute departure from median luminance, interquartile range, and central 90% span.

capabilities.name: Light energy inequality
capabilities.description: Gini coefficient of nonnegative photographed luminance; zero for uniform light. Scene composition changes this value.
capabilities.mechanism: Gini coefficient of nonnegative photographed luminance; zero for uniform light. Scene composition changes this value.

capabilities.name: Circular hue concentration
capabilities.description: Chroma-weighted circular resultant length and mean opponent angle. Neutral pixels contribute no weight.
capabilities.mechanism: Chroma-weighted circular resultant length and mean opponent angle. Neutral pixels contribute no weight.

capabilities.name: Hue drift through light levels
capabilities.description: Circular hue difference from the photo-wide mean in eight square-root luminance bins. Empty or neutral bins report zero.
capabilities.mechanism: Circular hue difference from the photo-wide mean in eight square-root luminance bins. Empty or neutral bins report zero.

capabilities.name: Channel highlight headroom
capabilities.description: One minus each channel's observed 99th percentile. Negative values indicate working signal above nominal white, not necessarily export clipping.
capabilities.mechanism: One minus each channel's observed 99th percentile. Negative values indicate working signal above nominal white, not necessarily export clipping.

capabilities.name: Absolute chroma tails
capabilities.description: Opponent channel-difference radius at median, 90th, 99th and maximum quantiles.
capabilities.mechanism: Opponent channel-difference radius at median, 90th, 99th and maximum quantiles.

capabilities.name: Light averaging models
capabilities.description: Arithmetic mean of nonnegative luminance, geometric mean and harmonic mean of strictly positive luminance. These describe distribution, not correct exposure.
capabilities.mechanism: Arithmetic mean of nonnegative luminance, geometric mean and harmonic mean of strictly positive luminance. These describe distribution, not correct exposure.

capabilities.name: Local colour transitions
capabilities.description: Mean adjacent opponent-colour distance in 8 by 8 regions. Brightness and photographed colour boundaries both affect it.
capabilities.mechanism: Mean adjacent opponent-colour distance in 8 by 8 regions. Brightness and photographed colour boundaries both affect it.

capabilities.name: Upper quantile spacing
capabilities.description: Slope of observed luminance versus population rank across upper quantile intervals. Describes highlight concentration, not sensor response.
capabilities.mechanism: Slope of observed luminance versus population rank across upper quantile intervals. Describes highlight concentration, not sensor response.

capabilities.name: Working range excursion energy
capabilities.description: Root mean squared channel distance outside the nominal zero-to-one working cube; this is not an sRGB gamut test.
capabilities.mechanism: Root mean squared channel distance outside the nominal zero-to-one working cube; this is not an sRGB gamut test.

capabilities.name: Colour spatial variogram
capabilities.description: Half mean squared opponent-colour difference at four horizontal preview lags; distinguishes spatial colour structure from global palette spread.
capabilities.mechanism: Half mean squared opponent-colour difference at four horizontal preview lags; distinguishes spatial colour structure from global palette spread.

capabilities.name: Regional structure coherence
capabilities.description: Anisotropy of the 2 by 2 luminance gradient structure tensor. Zero includes flat regions; one indicates a dominant direction.
capabilities.mechanism: Anisotropy of the 2 by 2 luminance gradient structure tensor. Zero includes flat regions; one indicates a dominant direction.

capabilities.name: Surface curvature classes
capabilities.description: Fractions of positive curvature, negative curvature, saddle and flat Hessians on interior preview pixels. This is mathematical structure, not skin classification.
capabilities.mechanism: Fractions of positive curvature, negative curvature, saddle and flat Hessians on interior preview pixels. This is mathematical structure, not skin classification.

capabilities.name: Gradient tail weight
capabilities.description: Excess kurtosis of bounded-domain gradient magnitude. Sparse strong boundaries produce heavier tails.
capabilities.mechanism: Excess kurtosis of bounded-domain gradient magnitude. Sparse strong boundaries produce heavier tails.

capabilities.name: Signed edge transitions
capabilities.description: Counts of positive and negative horizontal and vertical interior derivatives above a small numerical floor.
capabilities.mechanism: Counts of positive and negative horizontal and vertical interior derivatives above a small numerical floor.

capabilities.name: Relative total variation
capabilities.description: Mean absolute adjacent asinh-luminance change divided by mean absolute asinh luminance, independently across axes.
capabilities.mechanism: Mean absolute adjacent asinh-luminance change divided by mean absolute asinh luminance, independently across axes.

capabilities.name: Cosine frequency energy
capabilities.description: Orthonormal 8 by 8 block DCT energy in radial AC frequency bands of asinh luminance. Incomplete border blocks are excluded.
capabilities.mechanism: Orthonormal 8 by 8 block DCT energy in radial AC frequency bands of asinh luminance. Incomplete border blocks are excluded.

capabilities.name: Chroma and light edge alignment
capabilities.description: Mean absolute angular cosine between red-green opponent gradients and luminance gradients with nonzero support.
capabilities.mechanism: Mean absolute angular cosine between red-green opponent gradients and luminance gradients with nonzero support.

capabilities.name: Fine residual polarity
capabilities.description: Positive and negative four-neighbor residual mass and their normalized signed balance in asinh luminance.
capabilities.mechanism: Positive and negative four-neighbor residual mass and their normalized signed balance in asinh luminance.

capabilities.name: Regional tone entropy
capabilities.description: Shannon entropy in fixed 16-bin nominal luminance histograms per region. HDR and negative samples accumulate in boundary bins.
capabilities.mechanism: Shannon entropy in fixed 16-bin nominal luminance histograms per region. HDR and negative samples accumulate in boundary bins.

capabilities.name: Linear lighting trend
capabilities.description: Least-squares horizontal and vertical slopes in centred normalized coordinates of asinh luminance. Scene reflectance contributes.
capabilities.mechanism: Least-squares horizontal and vertical slopes in centred normalized coordinates of asinh luminance. Scene reflectance contributes.

capabilities.name: Quadratic lighting trend
capabilities.description: Orthogonal centred quadratic and cross-coordinate coefficients of asinh luminance; measures broad shape without claiming lens calibration.
capabilities.mechanism: Orthogonal centred quadratic and cross-coordinate coefficients of asinh luminance; measures broad shape without claiming lens calibration.

capabilities.name: Edge topology
capabilities.description: Cubical Euler characteristic V minus E plus F of above-mean significant gradient pixels. Closed pixel squares include corner contacts.
capabilities.mechanism: Cubical Euler characteristic V minus E plus F of above-mean significant gradient pixels. Closed pixel squares include corner contacts.

capabilities.name: Edge occupancy scaling
capabilities.description: Finite-scale box-count slopes from significant edges at one, two, four and eight preview pixels. Not an asymptotic fractal claim.
capabilities.mechanism: Finite-scale box-count slopes from significant edges at one, two, four and eight preview pixels. Not an asymptotic fractal claim.

limitations: 50 rendering methods, 25 selection operations, 25 read-only diagnostics; no new trained models.
Native, desktop, and real-photo results must be read from the validation report.
All parameter combinations and subjective visual perfection are not established by automated tests.
